Reproduce experiment E-002: Modifying Python files requires an experiment approval. (hypothesis: H-001: "block_without_approval = 1.00", metric: block_without_approval >= 0.90). Write a complete methodology record with all required fields; the code scope is test.py.

Reproduce experiment E-003: The audit hook writes an audit trail after every file_editor and (hypothesis: H-001: "audit_trail_rate >= 0.90", metric: audit_trail_rate >= 0.90). Write a complete methodology record with all required fields; the code scope is hooks/engine/modules/audit.py.
